metadata.name: master
metadata.description: Main development tasks for Minecraft Utility Client

tasks.title: Project Setup and Environment Configuration
tasks.description: Set up the basic project structure, dependencies, and development environment for the Minecraft utility client.
tasks.details: Initialize the project with proper Python environment, install required dependencies (tkinter/PyQt, minescript integration), set up version control, and create basic project structure. Ensure compatibility with Windows 10/11 and establish coding standards.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify Python environment works, all dependencies install correctly, and basic project structure is in place.

tasks.title: Minescript API Integration and Testing
tasks.description: Integrate with the Minescript mod API and create a robust wrapper for Minecraft interaction.
tasks.details: Study the existing minescript.py and minescript_runtime.py files, create a comprehensive wrapper class for all Minecraft interactions, implement error handling for API calls, and create test scripts to verify all API functions work correctly.
tasks.testStrategy: Create test scripts that verify player position, block reading, entity detection, and command execution work properly.

tasks.title: Core GUI Framework Development
tasks.description: Develop the main GUI application with dark theme, Minecraft-themed styling, and modular architecture.
tasks.details: Create the main application window using tkinter or PyQt, implement dark theme with Minecraft color palette, design modular interface that can accommodate different utility modules, and create basic navigation system.
tasks.testStrategy: Launch the GUI application, verify dark theme renders correctly, test window resizing and basic navigation, ensure Minecraft-themed elements display properly.

tasks.title: Configuration Management System
tasks.description: Implement a robust configuration system for user settings, profiles, and preferences.
tasks.details: Create configuration file structure (JSON format), implement settings persistence, create profile management for different worlds/servers, add import/export functionality, and implement hotkey customization system.
tasks.testStrategy: Test saving and loading configurations, verify profile switching works, test import/export functionality, ensure settings persist between application restarts.

tasks.title: Player Information Display Module
tasks.description: Create a real-time player information display showing position, health, inventory, and status.
tasks.details: Implement real-time player position tracking, display health and status information, show current inventory contents, implement orientation display, and add player name and world information.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify real-time updates work correctly, test display accuracy against actual game state, ensure performance is acceptable with frequent updates.

tasks.title: Basic Block Copy/Paste System
tasks.description: Implement core block copying and pasting functionality with safety checks and user feedback.
tasks.details: Create block selection interface, implement copy functionality using BlockPack API, add paste functionality with coordinate offset, implement safety checks for chunk loading, and add user feedback for operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test copying various structure sizes, verify paste accuracy, test safety checks with unloaded chunks, ensure proper error handling for invalid operations.

tasks.title: Block Management Tools
tasks.description: Develop advanced block management tools including fill, replace, and pattern operations.
tasks.details: Implement bulk fill operations, create block replacement tools, add pattern recognition for repetitive structures, implement block inventory management, and create structure templates system.
tasks.testStrategy: Test bulk operations on large areas, verify pattern recognition accuracy, test template saving and loading, ensure operations complete without errors.

tasks.title: Player Movement and Teleportation
tasks.description: Create player movement automation and teleportation features with safety checks.
tasks.details: Implement teleportation interface with coordinate input, create auto-walk functionality, add movement automation (auto-mine, auto-build), implement safety checks for dangerous locations, and add movement history tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test teleportation accuracy, verify auto-movement works correctly, test safety checks prevent dangerous teleports, ensure movement history is accurate.

tasks.title: Inventory Management Interface
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive inventory management tools with sorting and organization features.
tasks.details: Create inventory display interface, implement item sorting and organization, add item search and filtering, create hotbar management tools, and implement item transfer between containers.
tasks.testStrategy: Test inventory display accuracy, verify sorting functions work correctly, test search and filtering, ensure item transfers complete successfully.

tasks.title: World Information Display
tasks.description: Create comprehensive world information display showing chunks, biomes, and world data.
tasks.details: Implement chunk loading status display, create biome information viewer, add world statistics display, implement structure detection, and create world seed and version information display.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify chunk status accuracy, test biome detection, ensure world statistics are correct, test structure detection functionality.

tasks.title: Entity Detection and Management
tasks.description: Develop entity detection, monitoring, and management tools.
tasks.details: Implement entity detection and listing, create entity filtering and search, add entity tracking and monitoring, implement entity interaction tools, and create entity statistics display.
tasks.testStrategy: Test entity detection accuracy, verify filtering works correctly, test tracking functionality, ensure interaction tools work properly.

tasks.title: Basic Automation System
tasks.description: Implement basic automation features including script execution and task scheduling.
tasks.details: Create script execution interface, implement basic task scheduling, add macro recording functionality, create custom command system, and implement automation safety checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Test script execution, verify task scheduling works, test macro recording and playback, ensure safety checks prevent dangerous operations.

tasks.title: Event Monitoring and Response
tasks.description: Develop real-time event monitoring system with configurable responses.
tasks.details: Implement event listener system, create configurable event responses, add alert system for important events, implement event logging, and create event statistics tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test event detection accuracy, verify response triggers work, test alert system, ensure logging captures all events.

tasks.title: Advanced UI Customization
tasks.description: Implement advanced UI customization options and user preferences.
tasks.details: Create theme customization system, implement layout customization, add widget positioning options, create custom icon system, and implement user preference profiles.
tasks.testStrategy: Test theme switching, verify layout customization works, test custom icon loading, ensure preferences save correctly.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization and Testing
tasks.description: Optimize application performance and conduct comprehensive testing.
tasks.details: Profile application performance, optimize memory usage, implement lazy loading for large datasets, add error handling and recovery, create comprehensive test suite, and conduct user acceptance testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Run performance benchmarks, test memory usage under load, verify error handling works correctly, conduct full feature testing, gather user feedback.
